O <button> interno é br-button middle de 72×40 px com raio de pílula (não circular), sem nenhum texto visível — só o ícone projetado (eye, user-times) — e o nome acessível vem só do `title`. normas.texto: Every form input must have a programmatically associated label via: (a) <label> element with for attribute matching the input's id, (b) aria-label attribute, or (c) aria-labelledby pointing to a visible label element. Placeholder text is NOT a substitute for a label — it disappears on input and is not consistently announced by all screen readers.
